scripts.install-all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix apps/customer install && npm --prefix apps/restaurant install && npm --prefix apps/admin install
scripts.dev: npx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n SERVER,CUSTOMER,RESTAURANT,ADMIN -c "cyan,green,yellow,magenta" "npm run server" "npm run customer" "npm run restaurant" "npm run admin"
